sections.title: Renting a Flat
sections.scene: Telephone enquiry to a lettings agency
sections.overview: A caller phones a lettings agency about a two-bedroom flat: availability, rent, deposit, furniture and parking.

cues.speaker: Agent
cues.text: Good morning, Riverside Lettings, Daniel speaking. How can I help you?
cues.translation: 早上好，这里是河畔房产租赁，我是丹尼尔。有什么可以帮您？

cues.speaker: Caller
cues.text: Hello, I'm calling about the two-bedroom flat advertised on Mill Road.
cues.translation: 你好，我打电话是想咨询米尔路上广告的那套两居室公寓。

cues.speaker: Agent
cues.text: Certainly. Are you looking to move in soon?
cues.translation: 当然可以。您是打算近期入住吗？

cues.speaker: Caller
cues.text: Yes, ideally at the start of next month, if that's possible.
cues.translation: 是的，如果可能的话，最好是下个月初。
phonetic_notes: 连读: at the start of

cues.speaker: Agent
cues.text: Let me check. The flat is available from the third of March, so that should be fine.
cues.translation: 我查一下。这套公寓从三月三号起可入住，所以应该没问题。

cues.speaker: Caller
cues.text: Great. Could you tell me how much the rent is?
cues.translation: 太好了。能告诉我租金是多少吗？

cues.speaker: Agent
cues.text: It's eight hundred and fifty pounds a month, not including bills.
cues.translation: 每月八百五十英镑，不含水电等账单。
phonetic_notes: 数字连读: eight hundred and fifty

cues.speaker: Caller
cues.text: I see. And is there a deposit?
cues.translation: 我明白了。需要押金吗？

cues.speaker: Agent
cues.text: Yes, we ask for one month's rent as a deposit, so eight hundred and fifty pounds.
cues.translation: 是的，我们要求以一个月租金作为押金，也就是八百五十英镑。

cues.speaker: Caller
cues.text: Does the flat come with any furniture?
cues.translation: 这套公寓带家具吗？

cues.speaker: Agent
cues.text: It's partly furnished — there's a sofa, a dining table and a washing machine, but no beds.
cues.translation: 是半装修带家具的——有一张沙发、一张餐桌和一台洗衣机，但没有床。
phonetic_notes: 列举语调: sofa, dining table, washing machine

cues.speaker: Caller
cues.text: That's helpful. Is parking included?
cues.translation: 很有帮助。包含停车位吗？

cues.speaker: Agent
cues.text: There's a shared car park at the back of the building, but you'd need a permit, which costs forty pounds a year.
cues.translation: 楼后面有一个共用停车场，但您需要办理停车证，一年四十英镑。
phonetic_notes: 弱读: at the back of

cues.speaker: Caller
cues.text: OK. When could I come and see it?
cues.translation: 好的。我什么时候能来看看？
phonetic_notes: 连读: come and see it

cues.speaker: Agent
cues.text: We have viewings on Thursday afternoon and Saturday morning. Which would suit you better?
cues.translation: 我们周四下午和周六上午可以看房。哪个对您更方便？

cues.speaker: Caller
cues.text: Saturday morning would be perfect, thank you.
cues.translation: 周六上午就很好，谢谢。

sections.title: Enrolling on an Evening Course
sections.scene: Enquiry at a community college reception
sections.overview: A student asks about an evening photography course: level, start date, length, fees and what to bring.

cues.speaker: Receptionist
cues.text: Good afternoon, Northside Community College. How may I help?
cues.translation: 下午好，这里是北区社区学院。我能帮您什么？

cues.speaker: Student
cues.text: Hi, I'd like to enrol on an evening course in photography.
cues.translation: 你好，我想报名一门摄影夜校课程。

cues.speaker: Receptionist
cues.text: Of course. We run two levels — beginners on Tuesdays and intermediate on Wednesdays.
cues.translation: 当然。我们开设两个级别——周二初级班，周三中级班。

cues.speaker: Student
cues.text: I think beginners would be better for me. I've never used a proper camera.
cues.translation: 我想初级班更适合我。我从没用过像样的相机。

cues.speaker: Receptionist
cues.text: That's fine. The beginners' course starts on the ninth of April.
cues.translation: 没问题。初级班在四月九号开课。

cues.speaker: Student
cues.text: How long does it last?
cues.translation: 课程持续多久？

cues.speaker: Receptionist
cues.text: It runs for ten weeks, with a two-hour class each week.
cues.translation: 课程为期十周，每周一次两小时的课。

cues.speaker: Student
cues.text: And what's the fee?
cues.translation: 费用是多少？

cues.speaker: Receptionist
cues.text: It's one hundred and twenty pounds, but students and pensioners pay ninety.
cues.translation: 一百二十英镑，但学生和退休人员只需付九十英镑。
phonetic_notes: 数字连读: one hundred and twenty

cues.speaker: Student
cues.text: I'm a full-time student, so that's good news.
cues.translation: 我是全日制学生，这真是个好消息。

cues.speaker: Receptionist
cues.text: In that case, please bring your student card to the first lesson.
cues.translation: 那样的话，请在第一节课带上您的学生证。

cues.speaker: Student
cues.text: Will I need my own camera?
cues.translation: 我需要自己带相机吗？

cues.speaker: Receptionist
cues.text: We lend cameras for the class, but you'll need a memory card, which you can buy from the shop downstairs.
cues.translation: 课堂上我们出借相机，但您需要一张存储卡，可以在楼下商店购买。

cues.speaker: Student
cues.text: Perfect. Should I book online or come in?
cues.translation: 太好了。我是在网上预订还是过来报名？

cues.speaker: Receptionist
cues.text: You can register online, but the payment has to be made at reception.
cues.translation: 您可以在网上注册，但付款必须在接待处办理。

sections.title: Welcome to the City Library
sections.scene: Guided orientation tour for new members
sections.overview: A librarian gives a short tour of the building: opening hours, what is on each floor, how to join and borrowing rules.

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: Welcome to the city library, and thank you for coming to this short tour.
cues.translation: 欢迎来到市图书馆，感谢大家参加这次简短的参观。

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: The library is open from nine in the morning until eight in the evening on weekdays.
cues.translation: 工作日图书馆从早上九点开放到晚上八点。

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: At the weekend we close earlier, at five o'clock on both Saturday and Sunday.
cues.translation: 周末我们关门更早，周六和周日都是五点。

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: On the ground floor you'll find the main desk, where you can borrow and return books.
cues.translation: 在一楼您会看到总服务台，可以借书和还书。

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: Just behind the desk is the children's section, which has its own small reading area.
cues.translation: 服务台正后方是儿童区，那里有自己小小的阅读空间。

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: The first floor holds our collection of novels, travel guides and language courses.
cues.translation: 二楼收藏着我们的小说、旅行指南和语言课程资料。
phonetic_notes: 列举语调: novels, travel guides, language courses

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: If you need a quiet place to study, the silent study room is at the end of the first floor.
cues.translation: 如果您需要一个安静的学习场所，静音自习室在二楼尽头。
phonetic_notes: 连读: at the end of

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: The second floor is mainly for reference books, which cannot be taken out of the building.
cues.translation: 三楼主要是参考书，这些书不能带出大楼。

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: There's also a computer room on the second floor, where members can use the internet free of charge.
cues.translation: 三楼还有一个电脑室，会员可以免费上网。

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: To join the library, simply bring proof of your address, such as a recent bill.
cues.translation: 要加入图书馆，只需带上住址证明，比如近期的账单。

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: Membership is free for everyone, including visitors from other countries.
cues.translation: 会员资格对所有人免费，包括来自其他国家的访客。

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: You can borrow up to twelve items at a time and keep them for three weeks.
cues.translation: 您一次最多可以借十二件，并保留三周。

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: If you return something late, there's a small charge of twenty pence per day.
cues.translation: 如果您逾期归还，每天会收取二十便士的小额费用。

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: We also run a free conversation club every Friday at six, which is very popular with new residents.
cues.translation: 我们每周五六点还举办免费的会话俱乐部，很受新居民欢迎。

cues.speaker: Librarian
cues.text: Before you leave, please collect a map from the desk, and enjoy your visit.
cues.translation: 离开前请到服务台领取一份地图，祝您参观愉快。

sections.title: The Riverside Bus Tour
sections.scene: Recorded commentary on a sightseeing bus
sections.overview: A guide introduces a ninety-minute city bus tour: the route, main sights, stops and practical information for passengers.

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: Good morning, ladies and gentlemen, and welcome aboard the Riverside bus tour.
cues.translation: 女士们先生们，早上好，欢迎乘坐河畔观光巴士。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: The full route takes about ninety minutes, and you're welcome to get off at any stop.
cues.translation: 全程大约九十分钟，欢迎您在任何一站下车。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: We're now leaving the station and heading towards the old market square.
cues.translation: 我们现在正驶离车站，前往老集市广场。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: On your left you can see the town hall, which was built in eighteen forty-two.
cues.translation: 在您的左手边可以看到市政厅，它建于一八四二年。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: Just beyond it stands the cathedral, whose tower is the tallest in the region.
cues.translation: 再往前是大教堂，它的塔楼是本地区最高的。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: We'll stop here for fifteen minutes, so there's time for photographs.
cues.translation: 我们会在这里停十五分钟，这样有时间拍照。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: Our next stop is the botanical gardens, which open at ten o'clock.
cues.translation: 我们的下一站是植物园，十点开门。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: Entrance to the gardens is free, but the glasshouse charges a small fee.
cues.translation: 进入植物园是免费的，但温室会收取少量费用。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: After the gardens, the bus climbs the hill to the castle viewpoint.
cues.translation: 离开植物园后，巴士会爬上山坡前往城堡观景点。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: From the top, on a clear day, you can see the coast, some twenty miles away.
cues.translation: 从山顶上，天气晴朗时可以看到大约二十英里外的海岸。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: Please keep your ticket with you, as you'll need it to rejoin the bus.
cues.translation: 请随身保留好您的车票，因为重新上车时需要它。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: We break for lunch at the harbour at half past twelve.
cues.translation: 我们十二点半在港口停留吃午饭。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: There are several cafés there, and most serve fresh local fish.
cues.translation: 那里有几家咖啡馆，大多供应新鲜的本地鱼。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: We return to the station at approximately four o'clock in the afternoon.
cues.translation: 我们大约在下午四点返回车站。

cues.speaker: Guide
cues.text: If you have any questions during the tour, please ask your driver or guide.
cues.translation: 如果您在游览途中有任何问题，请问司机或导游。

sections.title: Planning a Group Presentation
sections.scene: Tutorial discussion between a tutor and two students
sections.overview: A tutor discusses a student presentation on urban transport: structure, argument, evidence and the opposite view.

cues.speaker: Tutor
cues.text: So, Mia and Ben, how is the group presentation on urban transport coming along?
cues.translation: 那么，米娅和本，你们关于城市交通的小组展示进展如何？

cues.speaker: Mia
cues.text: We've finished the research, but we're still deciding how to organise the slides.
cues.translation: 我们完成了研究，但还在决定如何安排幻灯片。

cues.speaker: Ben
cues.text: I thought we could open with the statistics, but Mia disagrees.
cues.translation: 我本来想用统计数据开场，但米娅不同意。

cues.speaker: Mia
cues.text: I'd rather start with a short story about a commuter, to make the audience care.
cues.translation: 我更想用一个通勤者的短故事开场，让听众产生共鸣。

cues.speaker: Tutor
cues.text: That's a good instinct. What's your main argument?
cues.translation: 这是个好直觉。你们的主要论点是什么？

cues.speaker: Ben
cues.text: That cities should spend more on buses and trains than on new roads.
cues.translation: 城市应该在公交和铁路上投入比新修道路更多的资金。

cues.speaker: Tutor
cues.text: And what evidence have you found for that?
cues.translation: 那你们为此找到了什么证据？

cues.speaker: Mia
cues.text: A study from Denmark showed that every pound spent on public transport created more jobs than the same money spent on motorways.
cues.translation: 丹麦的一项研究表明，花在公共交通上的每一英镑比花在高速公路上的同样金额创造了更多就业。

cues.speaker: Ben
cues.text: We also found data showing that bus lanes move more people per hour than car lanes.
cues.translation: 我们还发现数据显示，公交专用道每小时运送的人比小汽车道更多。

cues.speaker: Tutor
cues.text: Good. Have you considered the opposite view?
cues.translation: 很好。你们考虑过相反的观点吗？

cues.speaker: Mia
cues.text: Yes, we're going to mention that some commuters have no choice but to drive.
cues.translation: 是的，我们打算提到有些通勤者别无选择只能开车。
phonetic_notes: 连读: no choice but to

cues.speaker: Ben
cues.text: And that in rural areas, buses are often too infrequent to be useful.
cues.translation: 还有在乡村地区，公交往往班次太少而不实用。

cues.speaker: Tutor
cues.text: Exactly. A presentation that only shows one side is less convincing.
cues.translation: 正是如此。只展示一方的展示说服力较弱。

cues.speaker: Tutor
cues.text: How long will each of you speak?
cues.translation: 你们每人要讲多久？

cues.speaker: Mia
cues.text: We're aiming for five minutes each, with a minute for questions at the end.
cues.translation: 我们打算每人讲五分钟，最后留一分钟提问。

cues.speaker: Ben
cues.text: Do we need to hand in the slides before the presentation?
cues.translation: 我们需要在展示前交幻灯片吗？

cues.speaker: Tutor
cues.text: Yes, please upload them by Thursday evening, so I can give you feedback.
cues.translation: 是的，请在周四晚上前上传，这样我可以给你们反馈。

cues.speaker: Mia
cues.text: That's helpful. We'll send them on Wednesday, to be safe.
cues.translation: 这很有帮助。为保险起见，我们会在周三发过去。

sections.title: Why Cities Are Getting Hotter
sections.overview: A lecture on the urban heat island: its causes, who is most affected, and the measures cities can take.

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: In today's lecture we'll look at why cities are often several degrees warmer than the countryside around them.
cues.translation: 在今天的讲座中，我们将探讨为什么城市往往比周边乡村高出好几度。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: This effect is known as the urban heat island, and it has been studied for more than a century.
cues.translation: 这种现象被称为城市热岛，已经被研究了一个多世纪。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: The main cause is the materials we build with — concrete, asphalt and brick absorb heat during the day.
cues.translation: 主要原因是我们的建筑材料——混凝土、沥青和砖块白天吸收热量。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: Unlike soil and plants, these surfaces store that heat and release it slowly at night.
cues.translation: 与土壤和植物不同，这些表面储存热量并在夜间缓慢释放。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: A second cause is the shape of the city itself.
cues.translation: 第二个原因是城市本身的形态。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: Tall buildings trap heat between them and reduce the flow of cooling air.
cues.translation: 高楼在彼此之间困住热量，并减少了凉爽空气的流动。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: A third factor is the loss of trees and green space as cities expand.
cues.translation: 第三个因素随着城市扩张而失去树木和绿地。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: Trees provide shade, and they also cool the air as water evaporates from their leaves.
cues.translation: 树木提供遮荫，同时当水分从叶子蒸发时也会使空气变凉。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: The consequences are not equally shared.
cues.translation: 后果并非被平等地分担。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: Studies show that the hottest districts are often the poorest, which have fewer parks and more traffic.
cues.translation: 研究表明，最热的城区往往是最贫穷的，那里公园更少、交通更多。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: For elderly residents in particular, this can be dangerous during a heatwave.
cues.translation: 尤其对老年居民来说，这在热浪期间可能很危险。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: So what can be done? Several cities have started painting roofs white, which reflects sunlight instead of absorbing it.
cues.translation: 那么能做些什么呢？一些城市开始把屋顶涂成白色，反射阳光而不是吸收阳光。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: Others are planting trees along streets and creating small parks on unused land.
cues.translation: 另一些则在街道两旁植树，并在闲置土地上建小公园。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: One study estimated that a ten per cent increase in tree cover could lower summer temperatures by up to one degree.
cues.translation: 一项研究估计，树冠覆盖率增加百分之十可使夏季气温最多降低一度。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: Green roofs, which are covered with plants, are another option, though they are expensive to install.
cues.translation: 种满植物的绿色屋顶是另一种选择，尽管安装成本很高。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: Perhaps the most effective measure is to design new neighbourhoods so that air can move freely between buildings.
cues.translation: 也许最有效的措施是设计新社区，使空气能在建筑之间自由流动。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: None of these solutions works alone, and researchers stress that action must be taken on many fronts at once.
cues.translation: 这些方案单独都不能奏效，研究人员强调必须同时在多个方面采取行动。

cues.speaker: Lecturer
cues.text: Next week we'll examine how one city, Singapore, has combined several of these ideas.
cues.translation: 下周我们将研究新加坡这座城市是如何把其中几种做法结合起来的。
